other_accessions_not_analyzed.GSE129508: human window-of-opportunity RCT (Ligibel et al.), analyzed in S3.p5 / Fig 1A-B; not the requested series

assay: Lexogen QuantSeq 3' FWD RNA-seq of mouse left 4th mammary tissue with engrafted EO771 tumor cells; GEO deposits per-sample CPM
primary_estimand: Effect of 2 weeks of voluntary wheel running (before EO771 engraftment) vs sedentary housing on mammary-tissue gene expression, read out in the paper as a hypoxia signature score (lower in wheel runners)
sample_inclusion: Paper says 'mice randomized to exercise vs. control in GSE150620' (FIG1 C) and 'compared to sedentary control mice that also received mammary cancer' (S3.p6); it does not state n, nor whether the 10 clodronate-liposome (macrophage-depleted) mice were included
planned_contrasts: Wheel vs Control (sedentary) mammary tissue (S3.p6, FIG1 C; paper reports a hypoxia-signature TRA P = 0.003, no DEG count)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one mammary sample per mouse
paper_method: Transcriptome representation analysis (TRA) of a Buffa et al. hypoxia gene set (Supplementary Data File 1) on log2 expression; group difference in mean gene expression scores (FIG1 C). No gene-level DE model described.
normalization: GEO data_processing: STAR 2.5.3a normalized abundance, CPM per sample

paper_threshold.note: the paper reports no gene-level DE threshold; only gene-set TRA P values

paper_results.GSE150620: wheel-running mice had less hypoxia gene expression than sedentary controls (P = 0.003)
